**Hello, Solid Community 👋**

I've been quietly working on something for the past month that I'd love to share with you.

**First — Solid is incredible.**

The reactivity model, the zero-VDOM performance, the simplicity of the API. It genuinely deserves a much richer ecosystem. Which brings me to why I'm here.

**solid-mobile — a mobile UI component library for Solid**

- **53 components** across 6 categories (Form, Picker, Feedback, Nav, Display, Basic)
- 🎨 **Theme system** — CSS custom properties, light/dark mode, custom brand colors
- 🌍 **i18n** — en-US / zh-CN built in, extensible
- 📦 **Tree-shakable** — only what you use gets bundled
- ⌨️ **Fully typed** — TypeScript throughout
- 🧪 **480+ tests** — vitest, CI pipeline
- 📱 **Live docs** with a phone simulator: https://lxg19961206.github.io/SolidMobile/

The visual style draws inspiration from **Vant** (a popular Chinese mobile library) — but the design philosophy is adapted for Solid's reactivity model.

> Honest note: this project was first sketched in 2023, but I didn't have the skills to pull it off alone. It took until 2026, with a lot of help from Claude, to finally make it real.

📦 `npm install solid-mobile`
🖥️ Docs: https://lxg19961206.github.io/SolidMobile/

**About me — and what this needs**

I'm not a top-tier open source dev. I'm a regular engineer building things after work. I make mistakes. Some API decisions might be wrong. But I'm pouring everything I have into this.

**This is early beta.** Not recommended for production yet. I'm planning to spend ~1 month stabilizing before a stable release.

If you find bugs — open an issue. If you see a better way — open a PR. If you want to help build this — I'd genuinely love collaborators.

Wishing the Solid ecosystem the best. Thanks for reading.
